:::{#exr-rank-factorization-practice}
#### Finding a rank factorization of a rank-one matrix

A [rank factorization](#def-rank-factorization) writes an $m \times n$ [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) with [rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-rank) $r$
as a [matrix product](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-mult) of an $m \times r$ and an $r \times n$ matrix.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2}.
$$

Find a rank factorization of $\matr{A}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

In $\matr{A}$, the second column is twice the first, so $\rankf{\matr{A}} = 1$.

:::

:::
